summary: USA Rare Earth, Inc. (USAR) filed an 8-K disclosing entry into a definitive merger agreement to acquire SVRE Holdings Ltd. (SVRE) via a BVI merger, where SVRE merges into USAR's wholly owned Merger Sub. Consideration is stock-based, though exact price per share, implied value, and premium are not stated; the boards of both entities approved the deal. Closing expected by Q3 2026, subject to conditions. No advisors or break fees named. Watch for shareholder and regulatory approvals; risk-arb focuses on closing timeline and potential dissent rights under BVI law.
